sources.title: 熊本市第8次総合計画
sources.review_boundary: The current highest-level plan and its basic-concept/basic-plan structure are verified. Vision indicators, target definitions, denominators, and page-level evidence remain unreviewed.

sources.title: 令和8年度アクションプラン
sources.review_boundary: The annually renewed action-plan layer, four fiscal 2026 priorities, detailed implementation plan, and linkage to budget formation are verified. Individual projects, indicator values, and fiscal links remain unreviewed.

sources.title: 令和6年度行政評価・総合計画検証
sources.review_boundary: The current eighth-plan administrative evaluation route, indicator list, evaluation sheets, and deliberative review are verified. Source-reported evaluation judgments are not promoted to independent achievement claims.

sources.title: 令和8年度当初予算（案）関係資料
sources.review_boundary: The official fiscal 2026 initial-budget proposal, budget book, explanatory materials, requests, and project detail are preserved as proposal-stage evidence. These documents provide the detailed source values and remain distinct from the later approval evidence.

sources.title: 令和8年第1回定例会後市長記者会見・当初予算案可決確認
sources.review_boundary: The official March 24, 2026 post-session mayoral statement confirms that the fiscal 2026 initial-budget proposal submitted to the first regular council session was approved as originally proposed. This confirms enacted state but does not independently restate or promote proposal-line values to Reviewed.

sources.title: 熊本市の家計簿2025・令和6年度決算
sources.review_boundary: The fiscal 2024 settlement overview and unified-standard financial statements are verified. Account, statement, fiscal-indicator, audit, and policy-outcome records remain separate until record-level review.

quality_boundary: This complete source inventory confirms the current eighth comprehensive plan, fiscal 2026 action plan, current-plan fiscal 2024 administrative evaluation, detailed fiscal 2026 initial-budget proposal materials, official council-approval confirmation for the initial budget, and fiscal 2024 settlement. Proposal documents and enacted-state evidence remain separate, and no source evaluation judgment, indicator, project, budget value, settlement value, outcome, causal claim, or cross-city comparison is promoted to Reviewed.
next_action: Review eighth-plan indicators, fiscal 2024 administrative-evaluation evidence, action-plan projects, fiscal 2026 budget records, and fiscal 2024 settlement records at record-level evidence depth while preserving proposal-versus-enacted lineage and source-reported evaluation judgments.
